title: genlock snapshot is fast on busy projects: allFollowups/userQuestions stop rereading every question per session

fields.why: snapshot takes 8s in /Users/tj/nightmaremode; it feeds the Mac app and the phone Live tab via bridge status()

text: Profiled node --cpu-prof bin/genlock.mjs snapshot in /Users/tj/nightmaremode: 8.0s total; allFollowups (lib/followups.mjs:53) 7.6s, incl. followupsFor->readEvents 6.3s and userQuestions/loadQuestion (lib/ask.mjs) 4.2s re-reading question files. Other projects 0.2-1.4s. Read each record once per process (memoise), keep snapshot JSON byte-identical (diff before/after on nightmaremode + agent-genlock), then node tests/run.mjs (595 pass) and app swift test.
